Name: Hilkiah, the High Priest
Summary: Hilkiah the high priest received the temple repair money, found the book of the law of the LORD given by Moses, gave it to Shaphan, and went with the king's men to Huldah the prophetess; he also gave Passover offerings as a ruler of the house of God.
KeyStory: Hilkiah said to Shaphan, 'I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD,' and the reading of it rent the king's clothes and renewed the covenant.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Shaphan, Son of Azaliah; Huldah, the Prophetess
LifeLesson: Finding God's lost book can change a king and a kingdom.
